title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap **More info** on an item and paste the request there, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Iran says **three tankers** hit mines in the **Strait of Hormuz** and caught fire
items.summary_md: Iran's navy said one tanker was hit Saturday morning and two more later in the day on an unauthorized route; Reuters could not immediately verify the claims.

items.headline_md: Update: SpaceX's **Starship** ship was **caught by the launch tower** for the first time
items.summary_md: On its 15th flight test the spacecraft returned after about 22.5 hours and was caught at about 3:20 PM CT Saturday, a day after the booster catch failed.

items.headline_md: Update: Kremlin sets the **Trump–Xi–Putin** meeting for **Nov 19** in Shenzhen
items.summary_md: It will be on the sidelines of APEC; a US official says Iran will be on the agenda.

items.headline_md: **Quad summit** with Modi, Trump, Takaichi and Albanese expected **Nov 17** in Manila
items.summary_md: It would be the first Quad summit since 2024, on the sidelines of the ASEAN summits.

items.headline_md: Midterm counting: **Peltola** widens her lead over **Sen. Dan Sullivan** in Alaska; **Boebert** loses her House seat
items.summary_md: Counting continues nearly two weeks after the US midterms.

items.headline_md: Update: **Anthropic**'s IPO is several times oversubscribed at **$70–$78** a share
items.summary_md: The 825 million-share deal would raise about $64.4B at the top of the range (about $1.4T fully diluted); pricing is expected Wed Nov 18 and Nasdaq trading as "ANT" Thu Nov 19.

items.headline_md: **Elon Musk** and other tech execs sign a petition asking Nvidia to **reinstate Jensen Huang**
items.summary_md: The "Stand with Jensen" petition asks the board to restore Huang while an independent investigation proceeds.

items.headline_md: Nvidia's first earnings under interim CEO **Colette Kress** land **Tuesday** after the close
items.summary_md: Investors are watching its role as AI's financier, including about $36B in off-balance-sheet commitments to neocloud providers (CNBC).

items.headline_md: Update: after the FAA ground stop, **Sean Duffy** asks Congress for **$50B** to overhaul air traffic control
items.summary_md: He blamed the "incredibly old" system; cancellations and delays were expected to continue through the weekend.

items.headline_md: **Agile Robots** raises **$500M** at an **$8.5B** valuation
items.summary_md: SoftBank led the round, and Nvidia is among the investors.

items.headline_md: Update: **PUBG Mobile Flash** hits **No. 1** on the US iPhone charts
items.summary_md: The lightweight PUBG Mobile spin-off debuted at the top of the US iPhone games chart after launching worldwide.

items.headline_md: Capcom launches **Monster Hunter Puzzles: Felyne Isles Furever**, an offline puzzle game with **2,400+** levels
items.summary_md: It replaces the free-to-play original, which shuts down Jan 14, 2027; Switch and Steam ports are planned.

items.headline_md: **Learnings** topped Q3 mobile ad revenue at about **$135M**, ahead of **Voodoo** at $83.1M
items.summary_md: Voodoo still led downloads with 117M, while total downloads across 19 markets fell 7.3% from a year earlier (Sensor Tower).

items.headline_md: **Warhammer Survivors**, made with Vampire Survivors creator **poncle**, is out on iOS and Android
items.summary_md: The bullet-heaven game launched alongside PC and console, with 40+ characters and 75+ weapons.

items.headline_md: Samsung's **One UI 9.5 PlayOn Agent** brings game chats, events and rewards into system apps
items.summary_md: In-game chat shows up in Samsung Messages, and events and login rewards appear on lock-screen and home-screen widgets.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo or release from u/Mindstormman (checked GitHub and web search; r/decomps itself was unreadable from here today).

items.headline_md: Switch: **LAS Recomp Beta 6** adds **Android** and **iPhone/iPad** builds plus experimental frame generation
items.summary_md: Posted at 11:35 PM AZ Saturday and marked Latest, but it's still a beta and not yet called stable; it also adds touch controls, shadow and AO settings, and a detailed performance HUD.

items.headline_md: Update: **NX2navi 0.12.0** merges into **Triforce**, and its launcher now opens Triforce Setup
items.summary_md: Posted at 9:53 PM AZ Saturday. Existing builds, saves and settings stay, Play NX2navi still works, and Triforce's Convert saves page brings saves over.

items.headline_md: Switch: the **Pokémon Sword/Shield** PC recomp **v0.3.0** adds TAA/**DLAA**, ambient occlusion and mouse support
items.summary_md: Posted at 7:44 PM AZ Saturday; the dev says it holds 60 fps at 1440p and 4K on an RTX 3080.

items.headline_md: Switch 2: the **Pokopia** recomp (**Recompia**) moved to Dittobyte and shipped **0.13.7**, which fixes black screens on Intel GPUs
items.summary_md: Posted at 8:43 PM AZ Saturday after three quick hotfixes that evening; MHGU Recomp 0.17.3 and Bayonetta 3's Witch Time v0.10.1 also shipped small fixes.

items.headline_md: 3DS emulator **Azahar 2127.0** is at **RC3**, and **macXenos 1.0** brings Xbox 360 emulation to Macs
items.summary_md: Azahar adds ROM Bundles, a JIT-less FastInterp core for iPhone and a move to GPLv3+ (2126.2 stays the stable release); macXenos is a Metal port of Xenia Canary.

items.headline_md: Watch list: **Quiver Launcher 4.0.0-beta.5** is out but **not stable yet**, and **Longshot** keeps shipping nightlies
items.summary_md: Quiver's beta.5 was posted at 2:25 AM AZ; Longshot's newest is nightly-189 (4:10 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: Update: **Ebenezer** made **$6.7M** Friday with previews; Paramount still sees a **$20M** No. 1 opening, but rivals see it lower
items.summary_md: These are Saturday-morning projections for Nov 13–15, not final numbers. It has an A- CinemaScore, and the whole box office is pacing for about $80M, up 8% from a year ago.

items.headline_md: **Godzilla Minus Zero** is falling about **74%** in its second weekend to around **$8M**
items.summary_md: That would put it at about $48.5M domestic by Sunday; it made $73.6M worldwide in its first week (Friday projection).

items.headline_md: Update: **How to Rob a Bank** is pacing for about **$4.7M** (B- CinemaScore), and **Ghost Soldier** for **$4.9M** over three days ($8M over five)
items.summary_md: How to Rob a Bank cost a net $40M, versus a net $18M for Ghost Soldier (Saturday projections).

items.headline_md: A24's **You Can See Everything** is still pulling about **$4.5M** in its fifth weekend
items.summary_md: Its running total is expected to reach about $87.5M by Sunday (Friday projection).

items.headline_md: Next weekend: **The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** opens **Nov 20**, tracking for **$80M+**
items.summary_md: Presales are Lionsgate's strongest since the pandemic, early premium shows start Nov 18, and reviews aren't posted yet.

items.headline_md: **llama.cpp** reaches **1.0** with a stable API
items.summary_md: The local-inference engine behind Ollama, LM Studio and most on-device AI now promises not to break apps built on it without warning.

items.headline_md: **LangChain** raises **$300M** at a **$3B** valuation
items.summary_md: CapitalG led the Series C; LangChain says its LangSmith agent platform has 7,000 customers.

items.headline_md: IBM previews **Granite 4.1** models built to resist **prompt injection**
items.summary_md: The experimental 3B and 8B models separate instructions from data; IBM reports near-zero attack success on one benchmark but says they aren't for production.

items.headline_md: Anthropic's **Claude Duet** is an AI agent for people who don't code
items.summary_md: The Verge calls it surprisingly helpful for everyday work.

items.headline_md: Google DeepMind introduces **AlphaGenome 2** for genetic research
items.summary_md: It predicts how DNA variants change gene activity and is free through an API for non-commercial research.

items.headline_md: Unit 42: hackers used **autonomous AI agents** in 25 operations against at least 19 organizations
items.summary_md: The attackers combined the open-source Cairn framework with Zhipu GLM and DeepSeek models; 10 targets had access or data taken.

items.headline_md: Sony pulls **Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble** from the App Store and Google Play on **Nov 21**
items.summary_md: Its in-app purchases are already gone, and the servers shut down May 1, 2027.

items.headline_md: **Epic** urges the Supreme Court to uphold Apple's **App Store contempt ruling**
items.summary_md: Appdook listed it among Friday's Apple business and legal news; there are no further details yet.

items.headline_md: **Perplexity Teammates**, round-the-clock AI agents, reach its Mac app for Max subscribers
items.summary_md: Max costs $167 a month billed annually, and each teammate gets its own desktop and browser.

items.headline_md: Apple Maps in **iOS 27** quietly adds **Local Lists** of trending restaurants
items.summary_md: There are 1,021 lists of 20 places each, ranked by what people view, share and interact with in Maps.
The chip index fell 3.4%, but all three indexes gained for the week. US futures haven't opened yet (they open Sunday at 4:00 PM AZ).

items.headline_md: Rates: the **2-year Treasury** yield had its biggest weekly rise in 2+ years, and the **dollar index** hit a 19-month high (103.40)
items.summary_md: As of Friday's close, FedWatch put an 11% chance on a half-point Fed hike in December.

items.headline_md: Commodities at Friday's settle: **Brent $95.84**, **WTI $88.56** (both down for the week), and COMEX **gold $3,879.70**, down **4.55%** for the week
items.summary_md: Oil was little changed on the day as the focus stayed on a blockade of Iran rather than renewed conflict.

items.headline_md: **Bitcoin $65,303**, down **4.28%** on the day, at 5:04 AM AZ Sunday
items.summary_md: That's down from a $68,226 previous close.

sections.title: Weather
sections.body_md:
No ice storm or tornado threat for the St. Louis area through Friday, and no active NWS alerts for either point ([NWS alerts](https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=38.7875,-90.6299)). NWS St. Louis expects dry weather through at least midweek, with patchy river-valley fog this morning; a stronger system next weekend could bring 0.1–0.2 in of rain, with a 30–50% chance ([NWS St. Louis discussion](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=LSX&issuedby=LSX&product=AFD)).

items.headline_md: ⚠️ Low-confidence severe storm signal: **Sat Nov 21**, mid-Mississippi Valley including the St. Louis area
items.summary_md: SPC says isolated severe storms are possible Saturday as a system moves east, but confidence is too low for any risk area. There's no risk level and no ice threat; NWS has a 30–40% chance of rain Saturday and Saturday night.

items.headline_md: **St. Peters**: mostly sunny, high near **54°**, low around **30°** tonight, 0% rain chance
items.summary_md: It warms to the upper 60s by Friday, Nov 20.

items.headline_md: **Berkeley**: patchy fog 8–9 AM CT, then mostly sunny, high near **54°**, low around **33°** tonight, 0% rain chance
items.summary_md: It warms to the upper 60s by Friday, Nov 20.

items.headline_md: What happened to **hypercasual**? An Azur Games exec maps how the market shifted to hybrid-casual
items.summary_md: Worth reading in full (from April 2026) for its data on downloads, ad-versus-IAP segmentation and why new entrants drive growth, all directly relevant to your one-week casual games.
